# 03-path-shims: a PATH shim dispatcher for every JS client

`install` creates a shim directory holding tiny executables named `npm npx pnpm pnpx yarn bun bunx vlx`. Put that directory first on `PATH` and every call to those tools goes through a dispatcher, which can pass it through, add the registry profile environment, reroute dependency installs to vlt with a malware check, or run the real tool inside a nono sandbox. Nothing edits shell rc files or `$HOME/.npmrc`.

Each shim is four lines and execs one dispatcher with its own name as the first argument:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# generated by vlt-lab install (impl sh); do not edit
VLT_LAB_SHIM_DIR='/home/me/.local/share/vlt-lab/shims'; export VLT_LAB_SHIM_DIR
exec '/bin/sh' '/path/to/examples/03-path-shims/dispatch.sh' npm "$@"
```

There are three dispatchers (`dispatch.sh`, `dispatch.nu`, `dispatch.ts`) and three installers (`install.sh`, `install.nu`, `install.ts`). Any installer can install any dispatcher, and all three write byte-identical shims. Interpreters (`nu`, `bun`) are resolved to absolute paths outside the shim dir at install time, so a shim never runs another shim.

## Modes

`VLT_LAB_MODE` selects the behaviour (default `env`); `VLT_LAB_PROFILE` selects the profile (default `npmjs`).

| Mode | What the dispatcher does |
|---|---|
| `off` | Execs the real binary unchanged. |
| `env` | Loads the profile environment (`npm_config_registry`, `NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY`, `YARN_REGISTRY`, `VLT_REGISTRIES`, `npm_config_ignore_scripts`, ...), then execs the real binary. For a profile with `tokenEnv`, when that variable is set: npm, pnpm and yarn get `npm_config_userconfig` pointing at a rendered npmrc in `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vlt-lab-<uid>/<profile>.npmrc` (placeholders only, no token values), yarn also gets `npm_config_always_auth=true`, and bun gets `NPM_CONFIG_TOKEN`. |
| `vlt` | For a dependency install with no package arguments (`npm install\|i\|ci`, `pnpm install\|i`, `yarn` or `yarn install`, `bun install\|i`) runs `vlt install` (or `vlt ci` for `npm ci` when `vlt-lock.json` exists), then `vlt query ':malware' --expect-results=0`, and prints a summary on stderr. Native flags are dropped with a note. `npx`, `pnpx`, `bunx` and `vlx` go to `vlx` with the same arguments. Anything else behaves like `env`. A profile token named other than `VLT_TOKEN` is copied into `VLT_TOKEN`. |
| `nono` | Like `env`, but runs the real binary under `nono run` with the flag set below. |

`VLT_LAB_DRY_RUN=1` prints the command(s) instead of running them, and `VLT_LAB_DEBUG=1` logs each routing decision on stderr.

### Recursion guard

Real binaries are found with `vl_real_bin` / `vl-real-bin` / `realBin` from `lib/`, which skip the shim dir by physical path, so the dir listed twice or through a symlink is harmless. Each dispatcher also exports `VLT_LAB_SHIM_DEPTH`; at depth 1 or more it passes straight through to the real binary without loading anything, so lifecycle scripts that call `npm` are not re-dispatched. A missing tool prints `vlt-lab: <tool> not found outside <shimdir>` and exits 127.

The test suite found one more case. With two different shim dirs on `PATH` (say an sh install and a nu install), the first dispatcher resolves `npm` to the second dir's shim; that one passes through at depth 1, but its lookup only skipped its own dir, so it found the first dir's shim, and the two handed the call back and forth forever. Each dispatcher now appends its dir to `VLT_LAB_SHIM_SEEN` and runs the `lib/` lookup on a `PATH` with every seen dir removed.

### The nono flag set

For `npm install left-pad@1.3.0`, the dispatcher runs:

```
nono run -s --allow <project root> --allow-domain registry.npmjs.org --allow-command npm
  --read /opt/node22/bin --read /opt/node22/lib/node_modules/npm --allow $HOME/.npm
  --read-file $SSL_CERT_FILE -- /opt/node22/bin/npm install left-pad@1.3.0
```

Each element was found by removing it and running the install again (nono 0.79.0, 2026-10-04):

| Element | Why it is there | Observed without it |
|---|---|---|
| `--allow <project root>` (nearest dir with `package.json`, else cwd) | install writes `node_modules` and the lockfile | `--allow-cwd` alone grants read-only access: npm fails with `EACCES mkdir .../node_modules`. With the project root granted, `--allow-cwd` adds nothing, so it is left out. |
| `--allow-domain <each host from the profile>` | starts nono's filtering proxy | other hosts get HTTP 403 from the proxy (checked with `--registry=https://registry.yarnpkg.com/`) |
| `--allow-command <tool>` | the default profile's `dangerous_commands` group blocks `npm` | `nono: Command 'npm' is blocked` |
| `--read <dir of the real binary>` | exec of the binary and `node` beside it | exit 127, "its directory is not readable inside the sandbox" |
| `--read <package root of its realpath>` | `npm` is a symlink to `lib/node_modules/npm/bin/npm-cli.js` | exit 127. Skipped when it equals the bin dir (bun). |
| `--allow <tool cache>` (`~/.npm`; `$XDG_DATA_HOME/pnpm` and `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/pnpm`; `~/.bun/install/cache`; `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/yarn`) | global caches and stores | npm fails (`EACCES` on `~/.npm`); pnpm silently creates `<project>/.pnpm-store`; bun silently falls back to `node_modules/.cache`. The dirs must exist first: nono ignores a grant on a missing path. |
| `--read-file $SSL_CERT_FILE` and `$NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` (when set) | this machine's egress re-signs TLS | pnpm reports `self-signed certificate in certificate chain` and keeps retrying for over 2 minutes; bun fails with `FailedToOpenSocket`. npm happened to succeed without it under `--allow-domain`. |
| unset `npm_config_noproxy`, `npm_config_https_proxy`, `YARN_HTTPS_PROXY` (and the proxy siblings) | nono injects `HTTPS_PROXY`/`NO_PROXY`, but client-specific settings win over them | npm bypassed nono's proxy because `npm_config_noproxy` listed `registry.npmjs.org`, then failed with `EAI_AGAIN` (no DNS in the sandbox) |
| yarn only: `--read-file $PREFIX/etc/npmrc` | yarn classic aborts when the global npmrc exists but is unreadable | `error Error: EACCES: permission denied, open '/opt/node22/etc/npmrc'` (npm and pnpm only warn). Not granted to npm, because on this machine that file sets `cache=/home/claude/.npm`, which would move npm's cache out of the granted dir. |
| `--read-file` for `npm_config_userconfig`, `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/pnpm/rc`, `~/.yarnrc`, the vlt user `vlt.json` (when present) | user config outside the project | the tool silently runs with defaults |

`~/.npmrc`, `~/.bunfig.toml` and `~/.config/bun/bunfig.toml` are deliberately not granted. nono's required `deny_credentials` group blocks them even with `--read-file`; npm then runs with defaults (`npm config get fund` gave `true` in nono mode and `false` in env mode with `fund=false` in `~/.npmrc`). Inside the sandbox the profile environment, plus the rendered npmrc for token profiles, is the whole configuration. `--bypass-protection <file> --read-file <file>` overrides the deny (verified with `cat`), and is left to the user.

## Usage

```sh
sh install.sh --impl sh                     # or: nu install.nu --impl nu / bun install.ts --impl ts
export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/vlt-lab/shims:$PATH"    # the installer prints this line

npm config get registry                     # env mode: the profile's registry
VLT_LAB_PROFILE=gate-local npm config get registry
VLT_LAB_MODE=vlt npm install                # vlt install + :malware check, no package-lock.json
VLT_LAB_MODE=vlt npx cowsay hi              # runs vlx cowsay hi
VLT_LAB_MODE=nono npm install left-pad      # npm inside nono
VLT_LAB_MODE=nono VLT_LAB_DRY_RUN=1 pnpm install   # print the nono command line
VLT_LAB_MODE=off npm --version              # plain pass-through
```

`install` flags: `--impl sh|nu|ts` (default `sh`), `--dir DIR` (default `${VLT_LAB_SHIM_DIR:-$XDG_DATA_HOME/vlt-lab/shims}`), `--force` to replace files that are not vlt-lab shims. Run the installer again after moving the repository, since shims hold absolute paths.

## Results

Observed on 2026-10-04 with vlt 1.3.6, nono 0.79.0, npm 10.9.4, pnpm 10.28.0, yarn 1.22.22, bun 1.4.2, Nushell 0.116.0.

`sh test.sh`: **204 passed, 0 failed** in 37 s. It runs in a fresh `mktemp` HOME (with `TMPDIR` inside it), installs shims for all three dispatchers, and repeats every check per dispatcher.

| Check (per dispatcher: sh, nu, ts) | Outcome |
|---|---|
| install.sh, install.nu and install.ts write identical shims and identical output; 8 executables; existing non-shim files are refused | pass |
| `off`: `npm --version` equals the real npm (10.9.4) | pass |
| `env`, npmjs: `npm config get registry` and `yarn config get registry` are `https://registry.npmjs.org/`; `npm config get ignore-scripts` is `true` | pass |
| `env`, gate-local: npm, yarn and pnpm report `http://127.0.0.1:8787/` | pass |
| `env`, vsr-local with `VSR_TOKEN` set: `npm config get userconfig` is the rendered file, which holds no token value; without `VSR_TOKEN` the userconfig is untouched | pass |
| `env`, vlt-hosted without `VLT_ACCOUNT`: exits non-zero naming the variable | pass |
| Token delivery to a fake registry on 127.0.0.1:1337 (profile vsr-local) for npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, and vlt mode | every client sent `Authorization: Bearer <expected token>` |
| `vlt`: `npm install`, `pnpm install`, `yarn`, `bun install` each run `vlt install`, write `vlt-lock.json` and no native lockfile, install `left-pad@1.3.0`, and print `summary: vlt install ok; ...; :malware matched 0 packages` | pass |
| `vlt`: `npm install left-pad@1.3.0` (package argument) is not rerouted and writes `package-lock.json` | pass |
| `vlt`: `npm ci` with `vlt-lock.json` plans `vlt ci`; `npx cowsay hi` and `bunx -y cowsay` plan `vlx` | pass |
| Guard: shim dir twice on PATH; shim dir plus a symlink to it; a second shim dir of another dispatcher (logs `depth guard (VLT_LAB_SHIM_DEPTH=1)`); preset depth skips vlt routing | pass |
| Missing tool exits 127 with the exact message; unknown mode exits 2 | pass |
| `nono`: `npm install left-pad@1.3.0`, `pnpm install`, `bun install`, `yarn install` | all exit 0 and install 1.3.0; pnpm keeps its store outside the project |
| `nono`: a host outside the profile | blocked with HTTP 403 |
| Dry-run command lines for nono, vlt, env and off modes are identical across sh, nu and ts | pass |

Other observations, with how they were measured:

- **Token handling per client** (fake registry logging only whether the expected bearer arrived): npm and pnpm send the token only when `npm_config_userconfig` points at an npmrc with an `_authToken` line; environment registry variables alone send nothing. yarn classic honours `npm_config_userconfig` but sends the token only with `always-auth` (`npm_config_always_auth=true` or `always-auth=true`). bun ignores `npm_config_userconfig`; it sent the token from `NPM_CONFIG_TOKEN`, from `$HOME/.npmrc`, and from bunfig.
- **Registry variables**: bun honoured each of `BUN_CONFIG_REGISTRY`, `NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY` and `npm_config_registry`. yarn classic's `yarn config get registry` follows `YARN_REGISTRY` and still shows `https://registry.yarnpkg.com` when only `npm_config_registry` is set.
- **vlt**: `vlt install` prints a JSON change summary on stdout when stdout is not a terminal. Against a custom registry vlt also requests `/<registry path>/-/vlt/capabilities`. `vlt query ':malware' --expect-results=0` fails closed when api.socket.dev is unreachable: under nono with only registry.npmjs.org allowed it exited 1 with `TypeError: fetch failed`, and with api.socket.dev allowed it exited 0. Outside nono, vlt ignored a dead `HTTPS_PROXY` and connected directly.
- **nono refusals**: nono will not grant a directory that contains its own state root (`$HOME/.local/state/nono`), so nono mode fails when run from `$HOME` or a parent of it; it also refuses a grant on all of `~/.local/share` because that overlaps its keyrings deny, which is why the vlx grants name the `vlt` subdirectories.
- **Overhead** (mean of 5 runs of `npm --version`): real npm 89 ms; sh shim 104 ms (`off`) and 123 ms (`env`); nu shim 132 ms and 131 ms; ts shim 132 ms and 139 ms.

## Known limits

- Bun cannot `exec(2)`, so `dispatch.ts` keeps running as the parent: the child gets inherited stdio and forwarded `SIGINT`, `SIGTERM`, `SIGHUP` and `SIGQUIT`, and its exit status (or 128 plus the signal number) becomes the dispatcher's.
- In vlt mode, native flags (`--frozen-lockfile`, `--omit=dev`, ...) are dropped with a note, and `npm ci` maps to `vlt ci` only when `vlt-lock.json` exists. A malware match and a failed security lookup both exit 1; the query output is printed so the two can be told apart.
- In nono mode, user-level `~/.npmrc` and bunfig settings are invisible (by nono's design, see above), and npm does not see `$PREFIX/etc/npmrc`. The project grant is the nearest `package.json`, so a workspace root further up is not writable. yarn classic adopts an ancestor `package.json` that declares `workspaces` as its root and failed with `EACCES scandir` when that ancestor was outside the grant (observed for projects under this repository's `.tmp/`).
- Profiles whose registry is on localhost (`gate-local`, `vsr-local`) were not run under nono: nono sets `NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1`, so those connections bypass its proxy and would need `--allow-connect-port`. `not run`.
- For bun, `NPM_CONFIG_TOKEN` covers the default registry only; scoped registry auth for bun in env mode was not verified. `not run`.
- The rendered npmrc for token profiles stays in `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vlt-lab-<uid>/` (mode 700 dir) after the tool exits; it holds `${VAR}` placeholders, never token values.
- Real runs of `pnpx`, `bunx` and `vlx` were not exercised (only their routing, by dry run). yarn berry and deno are not installed. `not run`.
- Shims hold absolute paths to the dispatcher and interpreter; reinstall after moving the repository or the interpreter.

## Shared helpers worth moving to lib/

- `lib/ts/profile.ts` does not re-export `envPairs`; `dispatch.ts` imports it from `packages/registry-profile/src/index.ts`.
- The seen-shim-dirs lookup (`VLT_LAB_SHIM_SEEN` plus a filtered `PATH` around `vl_real_bin`) is needed by anything that dispatches through shims, and would sit naturally next to `vl_real_bin`.
